verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI code-review service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a hosted GitHub app with SaaS subscriptions and flex capacity. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment of the core product. The local CLI and MCP server are client tools that connect to cubic's service, not self-hosting of the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
